title: Austin Finalizes City Auditor Candidate List
meeting_type: Audit and Finance Committee Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   The Audit & Finance Committee has selected three finalists in the search for Austin's next City Auditor.
*   The recommended candidates are Spencer Bright (Seattle), Suresh George (New York City), and local contender Jason Hadavi.
*   These individuals will proceed to interviews with the full city body on Tuesday, October 21st.
*   This crucial step advances the process to fill the city's key independent financial oversight role.
